headline: Infineon lists internships and graduate roles for AMS model verification
fact: Infineon AMS verification internships were observed on October 5, 2026, with first posting dates unconfirmed. Andover assigns Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog behavioral models, testbenches, corner checks and regressions; Shanghai covers AMS IP/SoC environments and RTL/model integration. A related permanent Graduate – Analog Mixed-Signal Design Verification Engineer role (HRC1763746), observed October 6, specifies Verilog-AMS/SystemVerilog model generation and maintenance, testbenches, nominal/corner simulation, fault injection and regressions. It targets 2026/2027 graduates for January or summer 2027 starts; those start dates are not publication dates. These grouped advertisements establish hiring requirements, not deployed practices.
